**Cahaya Harmoni Hotel Sdn. Bhd. – Supplier Vetting Snapshot** | Item | Detail | |------|--------| | **Company** | Cahaya Harmoni Hotel Sdn. Bhd. (Private Ltd.) – boutique hotel operating in Kota Kinabalu, Kedah. | | **Founded** | 17 Oct 1995 (active) | | **Ownership** | 51 % Gemilang Holdings Sdn. Bhd.; 24.89 % Director 1; 24.11 % Director 2. | | **Key Executives** | • Managing Director – Director 1 (since 1996)
• Executive Director – Director 2 (since 1999) | | **Financial Highlights** (RM) | **2022** – Rev 9.0 M, Net profit 0.47 M, Total assets 10.0 M, Leverage 0.78×
**2023** – Rev 12.0 M, Net profit 0.85 M, Total assets 13.4 M, Leverage 1.15×
**2024** – Rev 16.4 M, Net profit 0.98 M, Total assets 18.3 M, Leverage 1.65× | | **Profitability** | Gross margin 55‑63 %; Net margin 5‑7 %; EBITDA margin 12‑14 % (stable). | | **Liquidity** | Quick ratio fell from 2.16 (2022) → 1.36 (2024); cash‑to‑revenue ~12‑15 %. | | **Cash Flow** | Operating cash flow positive each year; free cash flow turned positive in 2023 (≈ RM 718 k) and grew in 2024 (≈ RM 790 k). | | **Capital Structure** | Debt rising (borrowings ≈ RM 3.3 M → 5.99 M); interest‑coverage > 4×; leverage now > 1.5× total assets. | | **Audit** | Unqualified opinions for FY 2022‑2024 (Audit Firm 6). | | **Litigation** | None reported. | | **Risk Flags** | • Increasing leverage (1.65×) – monitor debt service.
• Liquidity tightening (quick ratio < 1.5).
• Inventory days high in 2023 (≈ 104 d) but improved in 2024. | | **Overall Verdict** | A financially growing boutique hotel with solid profitability and clean audit history. Main concerns are rising debt and modest liquidity; suitable if you can tolerate moderate credit risk and require a hospitality partner with proven cash‑flow generation.
